name: Beaumont-Hague
locality: Manche; canton of Beaumont-Hague; arrondissement of Cherbourg
text: Beaumont-Hague (French pronunciation: [bomɔ̃ aɡ], before 1991: Beaumont) is a former commune in the Manche department in the Normandy region in northwestern France. On 1 January 2017, it was merged into the new commune La Hague.

depictions.name: Beaumont-Hague
depictions.text: cod2 Beaumont-Hague is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty 2. It was released as part of the Skirmish Map Pack.
